# llms.txt — WeLux Digital Services

WeLux Digital Services (WeLux Group / WeLux Hub) is a digital services company from Luxembourg. Its website is https://weluxhub.com/ and its only public contact is info@weluxhub.com.

## Divisions

- WeLux Studio — Luxury digital & cinema studio (private office): luxury websites and online shops, 3D scanning and virtual twins (Matterport Pro3 LiDAR), cinema advertising, and film production.
- WeLux Careers — Interactive web CV and executive career acceleration in Luxembourg. Free for candidates (0 EUR upfront); employability support for people not in employment, education or training (NEET).
- WeLux Gear — Cinema camera and lens rental in Luxembourg, Madrid and Paris: Blackmagic URSA Mini Pro 4.6K G2 (Super 35), high-speed cine lenses (T2), ready-to-shoot filming kits and a glam photobooth.
- WeLux Films — Amcropa Films: the Group's film production arm.

## Services

- Digital studio: luxury websites and online commerce, 3D LiDAR scanning and virtual tours, cinema-quality content for premium products and real estate.
- Cinema rental: Blackmagic URSA Mini Pro 4.6K G2 cameras, Super 35 T2 cine lenses, filming kits and glam photobooth.
- Careers: interactive web CV, executive career acceleration, open applications and a waiting list.
- Films: European cinema production.

## Languages

The website is published in six languages: Spanish (es), English (en), French (fr), German (de), Portuguese (pt) and Luxembourgish (lu), at https://weluxhub.com/ and under /en/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/ and /lu/.

## Contact

- Email: info@weluxhub.com
- Website: https://weluxhub.com/
